---
title: "Trends"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
attacks <- read_rds("data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
attacks |>
  filter(!is.na(Activity), Fatal_clean != "Unknown") |>
  count(Activity, Fatal_clean, name = "attacks") |>
  group_by(Activity) |>
  filter(sum(attacks) >= 50) |>
  ungroup() |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = fct_reorder(Activity, attacks, .fun = sum),
    y = attacks,
    fill = Fatal_clean
  )) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "Activity",
    y = "Number of attacks",
    fill = "Outcome"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
